  • METR, F (against): Traced inflows in the ledger: no direct grant from Coefficient Giving in its index, but the 2024 spin-out transfer from ARC (seeded by Coefficient and SFF), SFF recommendations funded by an Anthropic Series A investor, a Longview pooled-fund grant, and about $21M through donor-advised funds and the Audacious Project whose underlying donors are not public.

Former advisors moved to Anthropic and to the OpenAI Foundation board.“Adam Gleave (Director)”
